openDecisions.question: Facets semantics. Note: books facets do neither, they are scope-only (book-facets.service.ts:23-31)
options: (a) each facet applies all other active filters and excludes its own (disjunctive faceting)
(b) every facet applies all filters including its own
(c) scope-only like books
openDecisions.cheaper: (b) is one filter for all; (a) needs one filter per dimension, built with toGlobalFilter overrides like overview() does (characters.service.ts:219-247)
openDecisions.recommendation: (a). Multi-select filters combine with OR inside a dimension, so under (b) choosing male would show female 0, which is wrong.
openDecisions.answer: Each facet counts with every other active filter except its own dimension.
